releaseNotes: IF GOOGLE PLAY PROTECT BLOCKS THE UPDATE (“Harmful app blocked” with only a Got-it button, no Install-anyway): that is Google's cloud scanner hard-flagging the cloner (same treatment the original App Cloner has gotten for years) — it is NOT a new bug in the app. Let it through once: open the Play Store → tap your profile picture → Play Protect → gear icon → turn OFF “Scan apps with Play Protect” → come back and tap Update again. 30 seconds, once. (If you can't update the app at all because of the block, do the same Play Protect steps, then update.)

Updates of the cloner itself now install QUIETLY on Android 12+ (no repeated confirm screens) and, when Play Protect blocks one, the app tells you exactly what happened and what to do instead of failing silently.

Clone installs blocked by Play Protect now show clear instructions on the progress screen too (steps: Play Store → profile → Play Protect → gear → turn off scanning → retry). Your logins and data are never touched by a blocked attempt.

New About/Help section: “Blocked by Play Protect?” explains the difference between the “Unsafe app blocked” warning (has Install-anyway) and the “Harmful app blocked” hard block (no bypass), plus the re-enabling trade-off.
Every update is still sha-256 verified inside the app before it is installed — a corrupt or tampered download can never be staged.
switcherReleaseNotes: No switcher dex change — the engine stays v4 (in-panel Switch Accounts above Quests + in-clone Update button; the cloner-side Update-all rescue from the previous release).
